id.description: The issue item ID this requirement comes from, e.g. AC-3, INV-1, TR-2, DOD-1.

literal_requirement.description: What behavior is literally required, read without looking at verifier conclusions.

evidence_expected.description: What evidence is supposed to prove this requirement.

single_interpretation.description: Whether the requirement has only one reasonable interpretation.

verify_proves_requirement.description: Whether the supplied Verify: mechanism actually proves the requirement.

rationale.description: Free-text justification for the status above.
